 then

 :component_prefix := '1';
 else

 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and

 End if;
 End If;
 
 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.component_prefix');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');

 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and

 End If;

 END IF;

PROCEDURE PRINT_LABEL (p_label_type in varchar2,
 p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_prod_code in varchar2,
 p_abo in varchar2,
 p_expdate in date,
 p_sp_testing in varchar2 := NULL)
is
 temp_v_pid VARCHAR2(30);
 temp_v_com VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_v_warehouse VARCHAR2(1) := name_in('GLOBAL.warehouse');
 temp_v_chapter VARCHAR2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 t_exp_date VARCHAR2(15);
 t_time VARCHAR2(1);
 print_license BOOLEAN;
 temp_v_label_string VARCHAR2(1000);
 temp_v_label_param VARCHAR2(1000); 
 temp_v_expdate VARCHAR2(16); 
 temp_v_cmv VARCHAR2(14) := NULL;
 temp_v_cmv_r VARCHAR2(5) := NULL;
 temp_v_cmv_res VARCHAR2(10) := NULL;
 temp_v_prod_code VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_v_lbltyp VARCHAR2(4);
 t_abo VARCHAR2(2);
 t_inst_name VARCHAR2(50);
 t_fac_name VARCHAR2(30);
 t_reg_no VARCHAR2(30);
 t_lic_no VARCHAR2(30); 
 t_addr VARCHAR2(50);
 t_lic_addr VARCHAR2(50);
 t_lic_city VARCHAR2(20);
 t_lic_state VARCHAR2(2);
 t_lic_zip VARCHAR2(9);
 t_lic_num VARCHAR2(30);
 t_lic_name VARCHAR2(50); 
 t_city VARCHAR2(20);
 t_state VARCHAR2(2);
 t_zip VARCHAR2(9);
 t_blood_type_code VARCHAR2(2);
 t_usage_code VARCHAR2(1);
 t_abo_only VARCHAR2(1);
 t_proc_msg VARCHAR2(70);
 t_coll_date date;
 t_month varchar2(3) := to_char(p_expdate,'MM');
 t_day varchar2(2) := to_char(p_expdate,'DD');
 t_year varchar2(4) := to_char(p_expdate,'YYYY');
 t_hour varchar2(2) := to_char(p_expdate,'HH24');
 t_min varchar2(2) := to_char(p_expdate,'MI');
 t_mf varchar2(1) := 'N';
 t_coll_flg varchar2(1);
 t_prod_typ varchar2(5);
 t_prod_form varchar2(80);
 t_chk_digit varchar2(5);
 t_bar_code_print_flag varchar2(1);
 org_t_prod_form varchar2(80);
 temp_user_id varchar2(6) := name_in('banner.user_id');
 temp_prog_name varchar2(8) := name_in('banner.prog_name'); 
 temp_isbt_or_codabar varchar2(1);
 temp_v_attr varchar2(3);
 temp_v_ip_address varchar2(20);
 temp_v_sec_def varchar2(10); -- This is used to store the port number like 5500 
 temp_usage_code varchar2(2); --this is created in the place of t_usage_code (t_usage_code is not being used )
 temp_contract_id varchar2(20);

 cursor c1 is 
 select attrib_code 
 from valid_product_cclass_attr_isbt
 where product_code = substr(p_prod_code,1,5);

 function In_dq (p_inp in varchar2) return varchar2 is
 begin
 return '\"'|| p_inp ||'\"';
 end; 

BEGIN

 --Added by Edwin. If the label type is OPD,OFF,PAD then the label will be considered 
 --as ISBT or it will be considered as codabar. 

 If p_label_type in ('PPD','PAD','OFF') then
 temp_isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 else
 temp_isbt_or_codabar:='C';
 t_month:=to_char(p_expdate,'MON');
 end if;
 
 --1) Get Printer
 IF name_in('GLOBAL.label_printer') is null THEN
 show_error('9032'); --No printer defined
 ELSE
 temp_v_pid := name_in('GLOBAL.label_printer');
 BEGIN
 SELECT code_info,seq ,second_definition
 INTO temp_v_ip_address, temp_v_com, temp_v_sec_def
 FROM rpt_master_codes
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON'
 AND code_type = 'LBLPTR'
 AND location_id = temp_v_warehouse
 AND code = temp_v_pid;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('9032'); -- Invalid Printer
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 temp_v_prod_code:=p_prod_code; -- Line added by Edwin on 03/22/01
 IF p_abo is not null THEN
 t_abo := substr(p_abo,1,2);
 ELSE
 t_abo := null;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN 
 SELECT inst_name, inst_short_name, reg_no, lic_no, 
 addr_1, city, state_code, zip
 INTO t_inst_name, t_fac_name, t_reg_no, t_lic_num,
 t_addr, t_city, t_state, t_zip
 FROM institutions i, addresses_lab a
 WHERE i.address_id = a.address_id (+);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;

 -- The following few lines are modified by Edwin to set the 
 -- Licensee information. For OPD no license information will be 
 -- printed as per KIM

 if p_label_type='PPD' then
 t_fac_name:=null;
 t_city:=null;
 t_state:=null;
 t_zip:=null;
 t_reg_no:=null;
 end if;

 print_license := out_of_state_allowed(p_unit_id, temp_v_prod_code);

 IF print_license THEN 
 if p_label_type!='PPD' Then -- For OPD the lic will not be printed
 t_lic_city :=t_city;
 t_lic_state:=t_state;
 t_lic_zip :=t_zip;
 t_lic_no :=t_lic_num;
 t_lic_name :=t_inst_name;
 end if;
 END IF;
 
 --Get the check-digtit -- Added by Edwin 

 -- As per Kim, if the contract id is internal set the processing message as 'Collected and Processed By'
 -- otherwise the processing message will be ' Processed By only ' Edwin on 08/31/2001

 Begin
 select contract_id into temp_contract_id from units where unit_id=p_unit_id;
 if temp_contract_id = 'INTERNAL' then 
 t_proc_msg:='Collected an Processed by';
 else
 t_proc_msg:='Processed by';
 end if;
 
 Exception when others then 
 message('Problem in getting the contract ID for the unit number');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End;
 


IF temp_isbt_or_codabar='I' -- If isbt then only do the following stuff
THEN 
 
 validate_unit_chkdigit(p_unit_id,t_chk_digit);
 t_chk_digit:=substr(t_chk_digit,2,1);

 IF t_abo is not null THEN
 Begin
 SELECT decode(tested_abo_code,'95','01','51','02','06','03','62',
 '04', '17','05','73','06','28','07','84','08', 'PO'
 ,decode(t_abo,'A0','83','B0','84', 'C0','85','D0','86','E0','87' ,
 'F0','88', 'G0','89'), '49','98','47','97','58', '94','39','96',
 'Md','95', tested_abo_code), usage_code, abo_only
 INTO t_blood_type_code, t_usage_code, t_abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values 
 WHERE abo_label = t_abo
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I';
 Exception
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 End;
 
 -- the above t_usage_code is not appropriate , so Kim cretaed another code in the master code table (IUSE), so that will be
 -- taken as the usage code : Refered with Kim on 08/29/2001
 
 Begin
 select code into temp_usage_code from master_codes where code_type='IUSE' and 
 rownum = 1;
 Exception when others then
 message('Could not pull up usage code from the master_code table for the code type IUSE');
 handle_error;
 End;
 
 ELSE
 t_blood_type_code := null;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT decode(life_span_ind,'H','T','F'), product_type, product_formula, nvl(manuf_product_flag,'N') 
 INTO t_time, t_prod_typ, t_prod_form, t_mf
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(p_prod_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 IF t_time != 'T' THEN
 For rec in c1
 loop
 t_prod_form:=rpad(rec.attrib_code,3,' ')|| t_prod_form;
 end loop;
 org_t_prod_form := t_prod_form; 
 LOOP
 temp_v_attr := substr(t_prod_form,1,3);
 IF substr(temp_v_attr,1,1) != '@' THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT decode(nvl(life_span_ind,'D'),'H','T','F')
 INTO t_time
 FROM valid_product_attributes
 WHERE attrib_code = temp_v_attr
 AND product_type = t_prod_typ
 AND sysdate between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date, sysdate)
 AND not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr
 WHERE attrib_code = temp_v_attr
 AND instr(org_t_prod_form,OVR_ATTRIB_CODE) != 0 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and 
 nvl(term_date, sysdate));
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 t_prod_form := substr(t_prod_form,4);
 exit when t_prod_form is null or t_time = 'T';
 END LOOP;
 IF t_prod_typ like 'PO%' THEN
 t_time := 'T';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END; 
 
 IF t_abo = 'Mf' or t_mf = 'Y' THEN
 t_coll_flg := 'T';
 BEGIN
 SELECT coll_date INTO t_coll_date FROM units 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter;
 t_month := to_char(t_coll_date,'MM');
 t_day := to_char(t_coll_date,'DD');
 t_year := to_char(t_coll_date,'YYYY');
 t_hour := '00';
 t_min := '00';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 ELSE
 t_coll_flg := 'F';
 END IF; 
 
 IF nvl(p_sp_testing,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 temp_v_cmv := 'CMV' ;
 temp_v_cmv_r := '1aaaa';
 END IF;

ELSE -- IF it is codeabar (temp_isbt_or_codabar='C') Added by Edwin for codabar
 If t_abo is not null THEN
 Begin
 SELECT decode(tested_abo_code,'95','01','51','02','06','03','62',
 '04', '17','05','73','06','28','07','84','08', '49','09','58','10',
 '47','11','71','12','40','13','39','14'), usage_code, abo_only
 INTO t_blood_type_code, t_usage_code, t_abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values WHERE abo_label = t_abo AND unit_scheme_type = 'C';
 Exception
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 End;
 Else

 If (t_hour='23' and t_min='59') then 
 t_bar_code_print_flag:='T';
 Else 
 t_bar_code_print_flag:='F';
 End if;

 -- As per KIM , if the label is 49 or manufaturing it should not print EXP date : Edwin 07-03-01
 
 If t_abo = 49 then
 t_day:=null;
 t_year:=NULL;
 t_hour:=null;
 t_min:=null;
 End if;

 --As per KIM , if the SLD id HOLD(39), NFT(47), MFG(49), BIO(58) or 71 then
 --don't print the lic no. By Edwin 08/29/2001

 If t_abo in ('39','47','49','58','71') then
 t_lic_no :=null;
 t_lic_city :=Null;
 t_lic_state :=Null;
 t_lic_zip :=Null;
 t_lic_name :=Null;
 End if;

 

END IF; -- For temp_isbt_or_codabar check (Added by Edwin when we incorporate the codabar label printing )

 IF p_label_type = 'PAD' THEN
 temp_v_label_string := 'PAD, ' || in_dq(temp_v_com) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_blood_type_code)|| ', ' || in_dq(temp_usage_code) || 
 ', \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\",' || in_dq(t_month) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_day) || ', ' || in_dq(t_year)|| ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_hour) || ', ' || in_dq(t_min) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_time) || ', ' || in_dq(t_coll_flg) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(temp_v_cmv) || ', ' || in_dq(temp_v_cmv_r) ||','||
 in_dq(t_proc_msg)||','|| 
 in_dq(t_fac_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_city || ' ' || t_state ||' '|| t_zip) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_inst_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_city ||' '||t_lic_state||' ' ||t_lic_zip) ||', '||
 in_dq(t_reg_no) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_no) || ', \"1\"'|| chr(10);
 ELSIF p_label_type = 'PPD' THEN
 temp_v_label_string := 'PPD, ' || in_dq(temp_v_com) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(substr(p_prod_code,1,5)) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(nvl(temp_usage_code,'0')) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(substr(p_prod_code,7,2)) || ', ' ||
 ',\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",' ||
 in_dq(t_month) || ', ' || in_dq(t_day) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_year) || ', ' || in_dq(t_hour) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_min) || ', ' || in_dq(t_time) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_coll_flg) || ', '|| in_dq(temp_v_cmv_r) || ', '||
 in_dq(temp_v_cmv_r) ||','||in_dq(t_proc_msg)||','||
 in_dq(t_fac_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_city || ' ' || t_state || ' ' || t_zip) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_name) ||', '||
 in_dq(t_lic_city ||' '||t_lic_state||' ' ||t_lic_zip) ||', '||
 in_dq(t_reg_no)|| ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_no) ||', \"1\"'|| chr(10);
 ELSIF p_label_type = 'OFF' THEN 
 temp_v_label_string := 'OFF,' || in_dq(temp_v_com) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(p_unit_id||'00'||t_chk_digit) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_fac_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_city || ' ' || t_state || ' ' || t_zip) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_lic_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_city ||' '||t_lic_state||' ' ||t_lic_zip) ||', '|| 
 in_dq(t_reg_no)|| ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_no) || ', ' || in_dq(substr(p_prod_code,1,5)) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(nvl(temp_usage_code,'0')) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(substr(p_prod_code,7,2)) || 
 ',\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",' ||
 in_dq(t_blood_type_code)|| ', ' || in_dq(temp_usage_code) ||
 ', \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\",' || in_dq(t_month) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_day) || ', ' || in_dq(t_year)|| ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_hour) || ', ' || in_dq(t_min) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_time) || ', ' || in_dq(t_coll_flg) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(temp_v_cmv) || ', ' || in_dq(temp_v_cmv_r) ||','||
 in_dq(t_proc_msg)|| ','||
 in_dq(t_fac_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_city || ' ' || t_state ||' '|| t_zip) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_lic_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_lic_city ||' '||t_lic_state||' ' ||t_lic_zip) ||', '||
 in_dq(t_reg_no) || ', ' ||

 IF p_label_type='PCA' THEN -- This is a codabar label

 in_dq(t_proc_msg) || ', ' || in_dq(t_fac_name) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(t_city || ' ' || t_state ||' '|| t_zip) || ', ' || 
 in_dq(t_reg_no) || ','|| in_dq(t_bar_code_print_flag) ||', \"1\"'|| chr(10);
 
 END IF;

-- host('lblprt.x "'|| temp_v_label_string||'"'|| ' ' || temp_v_warehouse||' '||temp_v_ip_address||' '||temp_v_sec_def ,NO_SCREEN);

 ---Intented use Ends here
